title: Trump Urges Ukraine to Cease Strikes on Russian Energy Facilities Amid Supply Concerns
snippet: Former President Donald Trump called for an immediate end to Ukrainian attacks on Russian fuel infrastructure, citing growing risks of global energy shortages and price hikes.
content:
Former President Donald Trump has publicly called on Ukraine to halt its ongoing military strikes against Russian fuel and diesel infrastructure, citing growing risks to global energy supplies and potential price spikes.

In recent months, Ukrainian forces have intensified targeted drone attacks on key Russian refineries and storage depots in an effort to hamper Moscow's logistics and cripple its primary source of war revenue. However, the resulting disruptions to regional production have raised concerns among international observers regarding worldwide fuel market stability.

Concerns Over Global Energy Markets

Addressing the impacts of the conflict, Trump stressed that continued damage to refining capacity threatens to deepen regional diesel shortages, which could eventually filter into broader international markets and affect American consumers.

While Ukraine maintains that targeting energy infrastructure is critical to defending its national sovereignty, Western leaders remain divided on the economic and geopolitical ramifications of striking Russian oil facilities.
